decisions.reason: Operator training builds directly on the firm's deep machine know-how, had its own page in both observed years, and supports customer use of its core machines, so the firm can easily absorb feedback and improve it.

A rotary axis accessory is a close extension of the firm's existing milling machine knowledge, so it is cheap to maintain and complements the core product line even though it was only mentioned on the website.

Hybrid additive post-processing lies furthest from the firm's established machining knowledge base, received only a mention, and would need external research cooperation to develop, so limited absorptive capacity makes withdrawal likely.

The high-speed CNC milling machine sits at the core of the firm's accumulated expertise and was presented on its own page, so the firm can interpret its market results and keep improving it through its own R&D.
An automatic tool change system builds closely on the firm's machine-tool competence and has a dedicated page, which makes it a well-absorbed complement to its CNC machines.
